user.title: Choose lamp
user.description: Supported Fluval lights that Home Assistant currently sees via Bluetooth.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported Fluval light found. Close the Fluval app (the light allows only one connection) and try again.
abort.not_supported: This Fluval light is not supported (only the current Bluetooth generation, see README).

data_description.keep_connected: On: Home Assistant stays connected (fast, keeps the state). Off: connects only briefly, so the Fluval app can be used in between.
data_description.weather_entity: On thunderstorms (and optionally clouds) the lamp briefly plays the matching effect and returns to its mix – at most once per hour, only while the light is on.
data_description.preferred_proxy: First connection attempt goes through this Bluetooth proxy (signal in brackets, if it currently sees the lamp). If it does not see the lamp, has no free slot or fails, another one is used automatically; the preferred one is tried again after 30 minutes.

set_channels.name: Set channels
set_channels.description: Sets the LED channels in % with one command. Channels not given stay as they are. All 0 turns the lamp off, any value above 0 turns it on.

get_programs.name: Read programs
get_programs.description: Returns the automatic and professional programs and the timed effects stored in the lamp.

set_timed_effects.name: Set timed effects
set_timed_effects.description: Like the app: up to 7 windows in which the lamp plays an effect by itself. Empty list = clear all.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: List of start, end (HH:MM), effect, weekdays (mon…sun, empty = all), enabled.

set_pro_program.name: Set professional program
set_pro_program.description: Writes a daily schedule (up to 12 points with time and the 5 channels) as professional program into the lamp; it fades between points itself and runs without Home Assistant.

points.name: Points
points.description: List of time (HH:MM) and the channels of the model (0–100): Reef pink, cyan, blue, purple, cold_white; Plant pink, blue, cold_white, pure_white, warm_white. Missing channels are 0.

activate.name: Switch to professional
activate.description: Switch the mode to professional afterwards.

not_in_range.message: The Fluval lamp is not reachable by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy right now ({error}). Is the Fluval app connected?

connect_failed.message: Could not connect to the Fluval lamp: {error}

no_answer.message: The Fluval lamp did not answer: {error}

not_confirmed.message: The Fluval lamp did not take the command, it reports: {state}

unknown_channel.message: This lamp has no channel {channels}. Channels: {valid}.

unreachable.title: {name} not reachable
unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has not heard from the lamp for {minutes} minutes (last error: {error}).

- Is the Fluval app open on a phone? The lamp allows only one connection.
- Is a Bluetooth proxy near the lamp online?
- Press **Reconnect** on the device page.

The notice disappears by itself as soon as the lamp answers again.
